label: Prospective mechanism PILOT on reused DEV, no independent confirmation
hypothesis: The quadratic J may rank broad pose candidates differently from local COS refinement. Factorizing their use can identify whether reduced failure tails and fine localization can coexist without more model training.
motivation: BF dense runs show COS/J strict-versus-loose tradeoff; EPFL512 does not show a direct J benefit. Registered full-step cost threshold failed. Test both datasets and all original trained objectives rather than assuming BF transfers.
theory: Original bounded-cosine J and exact empirical within-scene product unchanged. Switching search stage changes the application readout, not the estimator theorem. Hybrid policy is not maximization of a single global J.
control: All4policies for each problem use samecheckpoint/images/coords/perturbation/device/precision and unchanged host grid,3starts,100Adamsteps. Only coarse grid_values versus local __call__/value readout differs. Final selection and F_true use local readout. No cross-energy numeric score comparison. Rotate policy order byseed/problemindex. Same-job pure controls are necessary to measure stage intervention under prior evaluation noise, not occupancy reruns.
data: Gates first2sorted CALcores/windows, firstperturbation, all4trainedarms seed1001 per dataset. Full jobs allDEVcores/windows all10frozenperturbations. No newCALselection, noTEST.
endpoints: Paired scene-macro strict<9 andloose<42 success for eachpolicy/arm/dataset/seed; median/p95/failuretail, allscenes retained.
Coarse J effect atfixedCOSlocal; coarseCOS effect atfixedJlocal; localstage effects and interaction.
Same-policy VCS exact minusBCE/NCE andpermutation; no attributing generic search improvement to VCS training.
Perpolicy synchronized runtime and energy-callcounts. Grid andlocal budgets equal, walltime can differ.
primary_comparison: J_EXACT__COS minus COS__COS on each trained arm; other policies are mechanism controls, not an alternative winner selection.
success: Prospective useful-search signal on vcs_exact: mean strict gain>=1pp with >=2of3seeds positive, mean loose loss no worse than0.25pp, and median runtime ratio<=1.5, in EACH dataset. VCS-specific application evidence additionally requires the hybrid vcs_exact to beat identically evaluated BCE andNCE strict means by>=1pp with>=2of3seeds positive and loose means no worse than0.25pp in EACH dataset. Report all effects even if thresholds fail; thresholds are decision rules, not significance.
stop: No threshold/seed/model/scene/density changes, no retries or automatic training expansion. If no cross-dataset signal, close this fixed search-policy candidate. Failure blocks admission, retain attempt. No selecting alternative factorial cell as primary after results.

gates.cpu: Analytic coarse/local routing values/gradients and same-readout wrapper equals unchanged host optimizer exactly onCPU.
gates.gpu: Bothdatasets all4trainedarms: finite actual CAL registrations all4policies, recordedbudgetcounts; samecheckpoint COS F_true/perturbation/grid match historical tolerance1e-5+1e-4relative; wrapper grid/local values andgradients match direct current readout at same tolerance; sourceandweight hashes unchanged.
gates.admission: Only2technicalGPUgates enter existingpool after CPU PASS. All24full jobs held until bothgatesverify. No newcontroller.

limitations: RepeatedDEV and previously observed readout tradeoffs: exploratory evidence.
Originalsources trained under different objectives, fixedrecipe; no optimized-baselineclaim.
